title: Does One JetBlue Trip Make the Plus Card Worth It?
caption:
One JetBlue trip could cover the Plus Card’s $99 annual fee—if those bags would otherwise cost you money.

The example assumes two travelers each check a first bag both ways. The $35 charge is hypothetical, not JetBlue’s current price. This assumes both travelers qualify for the first-bag benefit on the same itinerary on eligible JetBlue-operated flights. Before counting savings, confirm your actual bag charges and current card terms, including any payment, TrueBlue-linking and advance account-opening requirements.

Carry-on only, or bags already included through fare or status? Skip the baggage justification. Already keeping the card? Don’t subtract its annual fee again for every trip.
